title: The prayer of Zakariya

phrases.text: His bones had grown weak, his head was white with age… and still he hoped for a child.
Prophet Zakariya, peace be upon him, was old, and his wife was barren.
He called to his Lord in a quiet, private prayer.
Allah answered him, and gave him the good news of a son named Yahya.
A name Allah had given to no one before him.
It is never too late to ask Allah. Share this with someone who is waiting.

caption:
Old, grey and still hoping… and Allah answered 🤲
The prayer of Prophet Zakariya (peace be upon him).
